current.text: He is projected to start at power forward for Milwaukee to open the season.
Milwaukee's starting lineup could change by December or March, and an August projection had Kel'el Ware starting instead of him.
Do not draft him inside the top 200. He is a projected starter but a terrible fantasy option.
Milwaukee lost Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bobby Portis from the frontcourt, which should give him more minutes.
Power forward is Milwaukee's weakest position, and he is one of the weak options there.
Milwaukee's roster needs trades to consolidate, and he is named as one of the players who do not fit well.
Milwaukee is expected to focus more on developing young players as the season goes on, which would cut veteran minutes.
Milwaukee has a new coach, Taylor Jenkins, who might use a deep rotation. Experts call the Bucks rotation very unclear.
Milwaukee is expected to be a bad team. Its win total is 26.5.

durable.text: He is a poor free throw shooter with poor steals and blocks. He does not make threes at high volume or a high percentage.
He was hyped early in his career but became a mediocre role player.
